ns2:course.label: Decision Support Systems
ns2:course.description: This advanced course examines recent developments in information technology for managerial decision support with an emphasis on Internet-based and mobile information technologies. Real-world eases will be used to discuss the application of these technologies to management information systems. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Informatics major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
